name: Halloween Night
description: A spooky Halloween theme with deep blacks, glowing greens, eerie purples, and pumpkin oranges.
author: VirtualDeck Team
css: .sound-card { border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px var(--shadow-color); border: 1px solid var(--border-primary); background: var(--bg-secondary); color: var(--text-primary); } .sound-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 8px var(--shadow-hover); transform: translateY(-1px); background: var(--hover-bg); } .twitch-btn { background: var(--accent-primary); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--text-primary); } .twitch-btn:hover { background: var(--accent-quaternary); } .modal-content { border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px var(--shadow-color); background: var(--bg-tertiary); color: var(--text-secondary); }
